item.title: In 2015, a US man paid $5.99 for a watch; after it was confirmed authentic, he sold it for $35,000
item.description: While exploring a Goodwill store, Zach Norris found a vintage LeCoultre Deep Sea Alarm watch priced at merely $5.99. After confirming its authenticity, the buzz around the watch attracted collectors from all over, culminating in significant bids.
